description: What a French micro-entrepreneur (auto-entrepreneur) pays to URSSAF for a month, quarter or year: social contributions (with or without ACRE, by business start date), training contribution (CFP), chamber tax, optional flat-rate income tax (versement libératoire), net income. Years 2025, 2026. Optional: VAT franchise check (franchise en base de TVA, 2026) — must I charge VAT, since when, margin left. Use when a user asks how much URSSAF contributions an auto-entrepreneur owes on a given turnover, what the ACRE reduction changes, how much remains as net income, or whether they must charge VAT (set verifier_franchise_tva = true). Deterministic code, no LLM, exact decimal arithmetic. Cross-checked on 2,000 cases against URSSAF's official engine (modele-social) and on 15 cases from the official URSSAF simulator; VAT franchise checked on the official worked examples of the tax doctrine (BOFiP). Not supported (refused for free with HTTP 422): mixed activities, furnished rentals and holiday lets, overseas departments, Alsace-Moselle craftspeople, lawyers and artist-authors, periods straddling the end of ACRE, ACRE in 2025, minimum-contribution option, exit from the micro regime, VAT check for years other than 2026. CFE and business expenses are not included. Price: 0.005 USDC per successful call, paid with x402 over MCP. Missing or invalid fields are reported for free with the questions to ask the user; you never pay for an error. Returns JSON (also in structuredContent): calculateur, resultat, detail (step by step), hypotheses, bareme (version, effective date, sources), estimation_indicative, avertissement, lien_verification. Full output schema and a real example: list_france_calculators.

acre.description: true if the entrepreneur was granted ACRE (reduced contribution rates for business creators).

activite.description: Activity category: vente_marchandises_commercant (sale of goods, restaurants, lodging by a trader), vente_marchandises_artisan (resale of goods by a craftsperson), prestations_services_commercant (commercial services, BIC), prestations_services_artisan (craft services, BIC), liberale_non_reglementee (other services or non-regulated liberal profession, BNC), liberale_reglementee_cipav (regulated liberal profession under CIPAV, BNC).

annee.description: Calendar year of the period. Supported: 2025, 2026.

cas_particuliers.description: Required. Special situations that apply, or [] if none: activite_mixte (several activity categories), location_meublee (furnished rental, holiday let, B&B), outre_mer (overseas department), alsace_moselle (craftsperson in Alsace or Moselle), double_immatriculation_cci_cma (registered with both CCI and CMA), cotisations_minimales (minimum contributions option), conjoint_collaborateur (collaborating spouse), sortie_regime_micro (turnover ceilings exceeded two years in a row), avocat_ou_artiste_auteur (lawyer or artist-author). Any listed situation is refused for free (HTTP 422).

chiffre_affaires.description: Turnover excluding VAT actually collected during the period, in EUR (chiffre d’affaires encaissé).

chiffre_affaires_n_moins_2_superieur_500.description: Required for trade and craft activities after the first calendar year: true if turnover two years before was at least EUR 5,000 (otherwise the chamber tax is not due).

date_debut_activite.description: Business start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Determines the ACRE period and the first-year chamber tax exemption.

mois.description: Required if periode = mois: month number 1 to 12.

periode.description: Declaration period: mois (month), trimestre (calendar quarter) or annee (calendar year).

trimestre.description: Required if periode = trimestre: calendar quarter 1 to 4.

tva_activite_saisonniere.description: Required for the VAT check if the business started this year or last year: true for a seasonal activity (thresholds are then not prorated).

tva_chiffre_affaires_annee_precedente.description: Required for the VAT check if the business started before the year: turnover excluding VAT of the previous calendar year, in EUR.

tva_chiffre_affaires_cumule_annee.description: Required for the VAT check unless periode = annee: turnover excluding VAT collected since 1 January of the year up to today, including the declared period, in EUR.

verifier_franchise_tva.description: Optional: true to also check the VAT franchise (franchise en base de TVA): must the entrepreneur charge VAT, since when, margin left before the threshold. 2026 only.

versement_liberatoire.description: true if the entrepreneur opted for the flat-rate income tax paid with contributions (versement libératoire).
